A B2B SaaS platform (Series D): a Technology & SaaS program run on the outcome-linked model with a blended Dataq Software team. The name stays behind the NDA; the numbers are published with permission.
Deploy frequency up but incidents ate roadmap; error budgets decorative.
LLM features shipped without cost telemetry or eval gates; margin diluting. SOC 2 evidence manual; enterprise deals stalled on security reviews.

The platform program delivered golden paths with SLO discipline and DORA instrumentation; the AI feature factory wired evaluations, guardrails and cost telemetry into the release train; and compliance-as-code produced continuous SOC 2 evidence — security reviews passed in days.
Outcomes, as the client reported them

items: the platform work made scaling boring, which is the highest compliment infrastructure can earn.
evaluation was an engineering artifact, not a slide: the models earned production by passing a set the client's reviewers recognized as their own.
the controls were architectural — identity-first, segmented, instrumented — not bolted on after the fact.
